sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks you should not be looking at grades at all. You should see three things: your child knows what to do when stuck instead of stopping, homework between sessions is being attempted rather than copied, and the tutor can name the specific gap in plain language. 'She is weak in Maths' is not a diagnosis. 'She can differentiate but cannot set up a related-rates problem, so Paper 2 question four is where the marks go' is one, and it tells you the tutor is actually teaching rather than supervising.

At one term, expect visible movement on one or two measurable things rather than everywhere at once. An internal assessment draft submitted on time instead of in the final week. An MYP criterion moving from the middle band to the upper one. An IGCSE past-paper section that used to be skipped now attempted. Roughly a term is also when any honest tutor should tell you whether the subject combination itself is the problem, which is a conversation worth having in DP1 and nearly useless in DP2.

Across one full exam cycle, from mocks to the May session, results come from the student's own work with the tutor as leverage on it. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and no honest IB and IGCSE tutor in Mumbai will either. Anyone who does is either charging for a promise they cannot keep or talking about a student who was already going to get there. What good tutoring reliably changes is the quality of practice between sessions, the number of marks lost to avoidable errors, and how early a problem gets spotted.

If it is not working, say so in week three rather than month three. The common failures are a personality mismatch, a tutor teaching above the level the student is actually at, and a slot that keeps drifting later. Tell us which of those it is and we move you to the next shortlisted name, who starts with the context already handed over: the subjects, the deadlines, where the previous sessions reached. You do not restart from the beginning, and you do not need an argument with the outgoing tutor to make it happen.

One term: one or two measurable moves, not improvement across the board

sections.heading: Starting home classes in the Western Suburbs: what to have ready
paragraphs: Five things make the first enquiry useful. The programme and exam year. The subjects and their levels, including HL or SL and Core or Extended where that applies. The school. Your locality to the lane, not the zone. And the two evenings you can genuinely protect every week. With those, a shortlist comes back with names, not categories. Without the locality and the slot, the shortlist is guesswork and the first session gets rescheduled twice.

Have the paperwork within reach for the first session too. The last report card, the two most recent assessed pieces with the teacher's comments still on them, the internal assessment brief if one has been issued, and the syllabus or subject code if you know it. A tutor who can read an actual marked script in the first twenty minutes starts teaching in session one. A tutor who has to discover the problem by asking questions loses the first two evenings finding out what the paperwork would have told them.

The first session itself is diagnosis followed by a plan. Expect the tutor to work through a past-paper section or the current piece of coursework with your child rather than lecture, to find where the understanding actually stops, and to finish by telling you both what the next four sessions will cover and what has to be done between them. Ask for that plan out loud at the end. If it does not arrive, that is your signal to take the next name on the shortlist, which is exactly what the shortlist is for.

Logistics last, because they are easy once decided. Pick the room, clear the table, agree the arrival time with a realistic allowance for the Western Express Highway in the evening, and arrange the standing gate pass. If you want a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai across two children, say so at the enquiry stage: sibling pairs in different programmes usually need separate tutors and a shared timetable, and that is far simpler to arrange before anything starts than after.

faqs.question: What do IB and IGCSE tuition fees in the Western Suburbs depend on?
faqs.answer: Five things, and we do not publish a price list because quoting one would be fiction. Board and level come first, as DP HL work costs more than MYP or primary support. Subject scarcity comes next: Computer Science HL, Music and Further Mathematics have far thinner tutor pools than Mathematics or Physics. Session length matters, and ninety minutes does not price as one and a half hours for a tutor who has travelled. Travel distance matters, which is why a Santacruz West tutor taking Khar West and the same tutor crossing to Andheri East in peak hour are different propositions. Finally, frequency: twice weekly through a term usually prices differently from occasional sessions before a test.

faqs.question: Will a tutor really travel to my building in Lokhandwala on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided the tutor is matched from inside the same stretch rather than across the city. Lokhandwala, Oshiwara, Versova, Four Bungalows and Seven Bungalows connect to each other off the Link Road and the internal lanes, so a tutor living in Andheri West or Versova reaches a Lokhandwala flat for a 7pm start without touching the Western Express Highway. A tutor coming from Bandra East or Chembur for the same slot is the placement that fails in week five. When you enquire, give the lane and the landmark rather than just Andheri West, and the shortlist will reflect who can actually be at your gate on time every week.

faqs.question: How does society gate access work for a weekly home tuition slot?
faqs.answer: Handle it once with the committee or facility manager and it never bothers you again. Most societies in Bandra West, Khar West, Juhu and the Borivali West and Kandivali East complexes will register a regular tutor for a standing weekly entry if the resident requests it in writing, usually with a name and a photo identity number. Without that, your tutor spends ten minutes at the gate every session and the class starts late. Also tell the tutor which gate to use, where to park if they drive, and which lift or wing to take. These sound trivial until you have lost a quarter of a DP2 session to a guard with no entry on his list.

faqs.question: Does online tuition actually work for a DP student in Vasai or Virar?
faqs.answer: Yes, and in the far north it is often the better choice rather than the compromise. Vasai, Virar, Mira Road and Bhayandar sit well beyond the school cluster between Bandra and Dahisar, so insisting on home visits shrinks the shortlist to whoever lives nearby, which rarely includes a specialist in HL Chemistry or Analysis and Approaches. Online removes that constraint entirely. What it requires in return is a written workflow: the student photographs or shares working before the session, the tutor marks it live, and a parent checks that the camera points at the page and not the ceiling. Many families here run one weekend home visit plus one online midweek session.

faqs.question: Who is the best IB and IGCSE tutor in the Western Suburbs?
faqs.answer: There is no single answer, and any page claiming one is selling rather than advising. The strongest tutor for an MYP 4 student in Goregaon West struggling with criterion-based writing is a poor match for a DP2 student in Bandstand finishing a Physics investigation three weeks before the deadline. What matters is whether a tutor has taught your exact syllabus at your exact level, whether they can hold your slot without the travel eroding it, and whether your child does the work between sessions. We shortlist against those three tests, show you the names, and expect you to judge the fit in the first session yourself.

faqs.question: Our school is in BKC but we live in Borivali West. Should the tutor be near the school or near us?
faqs.answer: Near you, always. The tutor comes to your home in the evening, so the school's location affects the timetable and the deadlines rather than the geography of the match. What matters from BKC is that Dhirubhai Ambani International School, the American School of Bombay and Ascend International School run bus routes that get a child home late, so your slot starts at 7pm or later. What matters from Borivali West is that the tutor should be living somewhere between Goregaon and Dahisar. A tutor matched near the school would be crossing the whole belt northwards in peak traffic twice a week, and that arrangement does not survive a monsoon.

faqs.question: There has been no progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Raise it immediately rather than waiting for the term to end. First, separate the two possible causes: the tutor is not teaching effectively, or the student is not working between sessions. Ask the tutor to name the specific gap and show you the last two pieces of work. If the answer is vague, that is a teaching problem and we move you to the next shortlisted name with the context handed over. If the work between sessions is not happening, a new tutor changes nothing and the fix is the weekly routine. We would rather switch a tutor in week four than have you pay through a term that is not working.

faqs.question: Can one tutor cover an IGCSE Year 10 student and an MYP 3 sibling in the same evening?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, within one subject family, and it is worth asking because the travel economics improve sharply. A Mathematics specialist can usually run IGCSE Extended 0580 and MYP 3 Mathematics back to back, since the content overlaps and the assessment styles differ in ways an experienced tutor already handles. Across subject families it rarely works: an English and Literature specialist should not be teaching MYP Sciences. Where it does work, the two sessions run consecutively rather than together, because a Year 10 student working on past papers and an MYP 3 student working on criterion-based tasks need separate attention for the full hour each.

faqs.question: A session was missed because of monsoon flooding on the Western Express Highway. What happens?
faqs.answer: It gets rescheduled, and the sensible move is to agree how before the monsoon rather than during it. Our standing suggestion to families between Bandra and Dahisar is a written rule from day one: if the tutor cannot travel, the session converts to online at the same time rather than disappearing from the week. July and August lose sessions in this belt every year, and a DP2 student with an internal assessment deadline in February cannot afford to drop three evenings to waterlogging. Settle the makeup convention, the online fallback and who decides by what time in the first conversation with your tutor.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram affiliated with Dhirubhai Ambani International School or the other schools named here?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent tutor-matching platform and has no affiliation, partnership or endorsement arrangement with Dhirubhai Ambani International School, Ecole Mondiale World School, Jamnabai Narsee International School, Oberoi International School, Thakur International School, Singapore International School, Witty International School or any other school mentioned on this page. We name them because their calendars, boards and assessment deadlines are the practical context a tutor in this belt works within. If any tutoring service implies a formal relationship with a school, or suggests inside knowledge of its internal marking, ask them to put that in writing and watch what happens.

faqs.question: How quickly can home classes start after I send an enquiry?
faqs.answer: Usually within a few days for mainstream subjects in the Bandra to Borivali stretch, and longer for scarce ones. The shortlist itself typically comes back inside a working day. What sets the actual start date is the overlap between your protected evenings and the tutor's free ones, which is why we ask for two specific evenings rather than general availability. Scarce subjects such as HL Computer Science, Music or Further Mathematics take longer, and in the far north around Virar and Bhayandar an online start is often available immediately while a home slot is still being arranged. Tell us your real deadline and the shortlist is built around it.

A shortlist of named tutors comes back, each with the syllabus they have taught and the slots they genuinely have free. sections.heading: How does IB Gram turn a Mumbai enquiry into a shortlist?
paragraphs: A Mumbai enquiry becomes a shortlist in four steps. You tell us the board, the year group, the subjects and three weekday slots that genuinely work in your household. We filter tutors on subject and board history. We filter again on travel, from where the tutor actually lives to where you actually live. You then receive two or three profiles with teaching history attached, rather than a directory of everyone free on Tuesday.

The travel filter is the step most people skip and the one that decides whether a booking survives past October. A tutor living in Khar who agrees to teach in Chembur on Wednesday evenings is crossing the Santacruz-Chembur Link Road (SCLR) at the worst hour of the week. They will mean it in June. By the third week of July they will ask to move the slot, and by late August they will cancel it. We would rather introduce a tutor from Chembur, Vikhroli or Ghatkopar who can still hold that same slot in February, when the Diploma Programme mock results land and the sessions matter most.

We do not run an automatic match. No algorithm picks a tutor and emails you a confirmation. A person reads the enquiry, because the information that decides the match is rarely on the form: a Diploma Programme year two student who has already changed Physics tutors twice needs a different kind of teacher from a year one student who is simply behind on Mathematics Analysis and Approaches. We also do not run an open bidding board where tutors undercut one another to win your enquiry, because the lowest bid tells you nothing about whether the person has taught the Internal Assessment you need help with.

Once you choose someone, the first session works as a diagnostic rather than a lesson, and you should treat it as a trial on both sides. If the fit is wrong, two sessions is usually enough to know. Tell us and we rematch. There is no contract to exit, no notice period and no argument about whether you gave it long enough, because a tutor your child dreads on a Thursday evening will not produce work however patient the adults are.

sections.heading: Which boards, programmes and levels IB Gram covers across Mumbai
paragraphs: IB Gram covers the International Baccalaureate (IB) continuum and both major International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) boards. On the IB side that is the Primary Years Programme (PYP), the Middle Years Programme (MYP) and the Diploma Programme (DP). On the IGCSE side it is Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel, along with the AS and A Level years that follow for families who stay with Cambridge instead of moving across to the DP at sixteen.

That spread matters more in this city than it would elsewhere, because Mumbai schools run several different pathways within a few kilometres of each other. Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu runs the full PYP, MYP and DP sequence. Dhirubhai Ambani International School in Bandra Kurla Complex and Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort take students through IGCSE and then the DP. Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane is an IGCSE school, and Singapore International School in Dahisar East is an IB school. A tutor who is fluent in MYP criterion-referenced marking is not automatically the person you want for a Pearson Edexcel past paper drill, and the reverse is just as true.

Levels are the second filter. In the DP, every subject is taken at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), and the gap is not simply volume: HL adds topics, longer papers and in several subjects an extra assessment component. In IGCSE Mathematics the decision is Core or Extended, and in the sciences it is coordinated science against three separate subjects. We ask which of these your child is actually sitting before matching, because a tutor who only ever taught Extended Mathematics will pace a Core student badly.

We cover Years 1 to 12, and the work looks nothing alike at the two ends. A PYP Year 3 session in Powai is about reading stamina and number sense with a parent in the room. A DP2 session in Cuffe Parade is about an Internal Assessment deadline three weeks away. What we do not do is pretend to be a school. We do not issue predicted grades, we do not write Internal Assessments or Extended Essays, and we do not negotiate with teachers on your behalf. Families with two children on two different boards sometimes ask for one all IB and IGCSE subjects home tutor in Mumbai to handle both, and that person is rarely real; two matched tutors on two evenings works better than one generalist stretched across four syllabuses.

sections.heading: Which subjects and levels do Mumbai families most often ask us to cover?
paragraphs: The three requests that arrive most often from Mumbai parents are Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry, followed by Economics and Business Management, then English and the second languages. The pattern holds across both boards, and it is driven less by difficulty than by the assessments attached. A subject with a heavy Internal Assessment (IA) component generates a tutoring request at a predictable point in the year, whichever school the child attends.

Subject choice itself is the part families most often get wrong without noticing. In the DP, Mathematics splits into Analysis and Approaches and Applications and Interpretation, and the choice follows the degree the student is aiming at rather than the grade that looks easier this term. Engineering and Economics courses abroad commonly expect Analysis and Approaches, often at HL. Moving across in DP1 is possible and painful; moving in DP2 is usually not realistic. We will say so plainly if a parent asks us to arrange tutoring that props up a subject the student should probably drop at the end of year one instead.

The assessments are where a tutor earns their slot. Group 4 sciences carry a scientific investigation marked on research design, data analysis and conclusion, which means the tutor has to be able to argue about uncertainty propagation, not just explain the theory. Business Management and Economics carry commentaries that rely on a real organisation or a real article, and the marks sit in the application rather than the summary. Mathematics carries an exploration where topic choice decides the ceiling. Across IGCSE, the equivalent pressure sits in coursework components and in the practical papers, where a student who has only ever read the theory loses marks on method.

Then there is the DP Core: the Extended Essay (EE), Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and Creativity, Activity, Service. The EE and the TOK essay together carry points that change a final total, and both are written in the same stretch of the year as the subject IAs. A tutor can supervise structure, argument and referencing discipline. A tutor cannot write it, and a tutor who offers to is telling you something about how they work.

sections.heading: Home tuition across Mumbai: South Mumbai, the suburbs, Navi Mumbai and Thane
paragraphs: Local supply is the reason a question about a platform turns into a question about geography. Mumbai, Maharashtra is one labour market for tutors on paper and six separate ones in practice, because the travel between them does not work on a weekday evening. We match within zones, which is also a large part of why parents choose IB Gram in Mumbai rather than hiring whoever answered first. Most families begin with a search for IB tutors near me Mumbai, which returns a map and very little else, and then find that the name at the top of it cannot actually reach their building at six in the evening.

South Mumbai is dense, short-distance and slow. A tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers eight kilometres and can still lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak, even with the Coastal Road open. The Western Line to Churchgate, Grant Road and Mumbai Central, the Harbour Line through Dockyard and Sewri, and Metro Line 3 from Cuffe Parade to Bandra Kurla Complex all help a tutor who is already on the island. They do very little for a tutor living in Kandivali, which is why we match Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Tardeo and Fort families from within South Mumbai.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Express Highway and the Western Line, so Bandra to Andheri is quick off-peak and painful at six in the evening. Matching along the line, Khar to Santacruz or Malad to Kandivali, works far better than matching across it. Metro Line 1 from Versova through Andheri to Ghatkopar and Metro Lines 2A and 7 from Dahisar to Gundavali have changed this for the better, and a Juhu or Borivali family now has a wider pool than two years ago. The Central Suburbs sit on the Central Line from Kurla to Mulund and on the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali hanging off the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road (JVLR) in between. Powai is the odd one out: physically central, with no station of its own, so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar.

The Eastern Suburbs stretch from Chembur and Govandi up through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund on the Central and Harbour lines, and the Eastern Freeway makes South Mumbai reachable from Chembur and Wadala far faster than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, each a short drive from the next along Palm Beach Road and the Sion Panvel Highway; the Atal Setu has cut the crossing time from the island, but pulling a tutor across the creek for a weekday evening lesson still rarely holds for a full term. Thane spreads west to east from the station across Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, and the Ghodbunder stretch sets the schedule: a tutor near the station reaches Kasarvadavali in twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening. Thane tutors cover Thane, and Mulund tutors sometimes cross over on the Eastern Express Highway.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar that sets your tutoring timetable
paragraphs: Mumbai international schools sit on an academic year that opens in late July or August and closes in April or May, and that single fact decides when tutoring helps and when it only consoles. The May examination session is the one most Mumbai DP students sit, so the DP2 year compresses almost every Internal Assessment deadline into the stretch between the Diwali break and the end of January, with mocks immediately behind them. A family that starts looking for a tutor in March of DP2 has bought themselves revision support, not teaching time.

The pressure points repeat every year. August and September are when DP1 students discover that MYP or IGCSE study habits do not carry over, and when IGCSE Year 10 students meet coursework for the first time. October and November are Extended Essay draft season, overlapping the first science investigations. January and February bring the Theory of Knowledge essay, the final IA submissions and the mocks in the same six weeks. March and April are revision, past papers and timing practice. The October and November IGCSE series shifts all of this for the Cambridge and Pearson Edexcel students who sit it, which is why we ask for the series and not just the year group.

Mumbai adds its own interruptions on top. The monsoon from mid-June through July closes schools at short notice and makes a Ghodbunder Road or Western Express Highway commute unpredictable, so a tutor who is already in your node keeps the session and one who is travelling twenty kilometres does not. Ganesh Chaturthi takes out a week of road capacity in large parts of the city. The Diwali break is the one honest block of catch-up time in the DP2 year, and families who use it well arrive at the January crunch in a different position from families who treat it as a holiday.

Schools appear on this page as context and nothing more. Families we work with attend Bombay International School in Babulnath, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade, Jamnabai Narsee International School in Juhu, Oberoi International School on JVLR, Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai, NES International School in Mulund West and D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul, among many others. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named here, with the International Baccalaureate Organisation, with Cambridge International Education or with Pearson Edexcel. Naming a school tells you we know its calendar. It does not tell you anything else.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: which one suits your Mumbai week?
paragraphs: Home tuition is the lead service and the right default for most families here, because it removes the travel that otherwise falls on a tired student. An IB home tuition slot in Mumbai costs the tutor the commute rather than the child, and for a DP2 student who leaves school at half past three and gets back at half past four, that difference is the whole session. Home tuition also gives the tutor information no video call provides: the desk, the noise, the siblings, the phone face down or face up, and whether last week's work was actually attempted.

The honest cost of home tuition is scarcity and price. A tutor who travels can hold fewer slots in a week, so the scarce ones go early, and the sessions that survive a full term are the ones inside a sensible radius. If you want an IB home tutor in Mumbai for a subject with a thin local pool, HL Further Mathematics or a second language at HL, you may wait, or you may compromise on the day rather than on the person. That is one reason why families choose IB Gram in Mumbai rather than ringing round on their own: the matching happens against who can genuinely hold your slot, not against who is willing to say yes in July.

Online tutoring solves exactly that scarcity problem, and it is a real option rather than a fallback. An IB online tutor in Mumbai can be the specialist who happens to live in Thane while you live in Worli, and the session starts on time whatever the Sea Link is doing. The trade-offs are also real. Younger students, roughly PYP and early MYP, lose focus faster without an adult at the table. Diagram-heavy work, titration write-ups and hand-drawn graphs are slower to share. A student who is disengaged rather than behind will manage a camera far more effectively than they manage a person in the room.

Hybrid is what most of our longer-running arrangements settle into, and it is usually the sensible answer rather than a compromise. The standing weekly session happens at home, where the teaching and the accountability sit. A second shorter online slot handles a specific question before a deadline, a past paper walked through on a screen, or the week a tutor cannot reach Kharghar because Palm Beach Road has stopped moving. Families who agree the hybrid pattern at the start lose far fewer sessions over a term than families who only rearrange when something goes wrong.

sections.heading: What IB Gram checks before a home tutor reaches your door, and what you should check
paragraphs: Verification is the part of why choose IB Gram in Mumbai that is easiest for you to audit, so here is exactly what it covers. We confirm identity against a government photograph identity document. We confirm the degree or qualification the tutor claims, in the subject they want to teach. We confirm board and level experience specifically: not that someone has taught Physics, but that they have taught DP Physics HL, or Cambridge IGCSE Physics, and roughly for how long. We ask for references from previous tutoring or teaching work and we contact them.

What verification cannot do is predict chemistry with your child, and no screening process anywhere can. A tutor can hold a strong subject record and still be the wrong person for a quiet fourteen year old who shuts down when corrected directly. This is why the first session matters more than the profile, and why the replacement path exists and is used. Treating verification as a guarantee of outcome is the single most common misunderstanding about platforms generally, and we would rather you came in knowing the difference.

Your own checks are worth more than people expect, and they take about ten minutes. Ask the tutor which assessment criteria the current piece of work is marked against, by name. Ask what a specific student did badly on last year and what they changed. Hand over one past paper question from your child's actual syllabus and watch how they explain it. A tutor who has taught the course will reach for the mark scheme language without thinking about it, and one who has only studied the subject will explain the concept beautifully and miss the marks.

On the practical side, verify the arrangements rather than trusting them. Confirm the tutor's name as it should be given at the society gate, keep the first few sessions in a room with an open door or in the building's study area, and agree in writing what happens to a cancelled session. Ask whether the tutor is coming by train, metro or road, because that answer predicts punctuality in August better than any promise does. None of this is distrust. It is the same diligence you would apply to anyone who comes to your home weekly.

sections.heading: School teacher, coaching class, chain institute, marketplace or platform: which fits?
paragraphs: A Mumbai family looking for IB or IGCSE support has at least six genuine alternatives, and a platform is only one of them. Taken honestly, each is good at something the others are not. A teacher from your child's own school knows the exact internal assessment criteria, the marking culture and what that department actually rewards, which no outsider can replicate. The limits are equally clear: slots are few, many schools restrict staff from privately teaching their own students, the conflict of interest is awkward when a grade is disputed, and that teacher cannot help you if your child moves boards.

A neighbourhood coaching class is the cheapest hour on this list and the best environment for drilling past papers against a clock, because a room of students sitting the same paper creates a pace an individual session struggles to match. What a coaching class is not built for is a single child who is two topics behind, or an Internal Assessment that needs a one-to-one conversation about research design. The group moves at the group's pace, mixed boards often sit in the same room, and the student who needs a fortnight of back-filling does not get it. A large chain institute solves the structure problem: published material, a test series, a syllabus plan and a replacement teacher if yours resigns in November. In exchange, teacher allocation is not yours to make, rotation mid-term is normal, pacing is standard across a batch rather than built for your child, and you travel to them, which in this city is the hidden cost.

An online marketplace gives you the widest choice and the fastest booking anywhere, and if you enjoy screening people it is a strong tool. The work it hands back to you is the vetting: you confirm the qualifications, you judge the board experience, and you carry the risk if the tutor turns out to be teaching a syllabus they learned from a video. Many marketplace tutors are online only and some sit outside India, so a Mumbai calendar, a Mumbai mock schedule and a Ghodbunder Road evening mean nothing to them. A recommendation from another parent at your own school is the strongest single signal in this whole list and costs nothing, but it is a sample of one: the tutor who transformed a neighbour's Economics grade may be full, may not teach your child's subject, and may suit a different temperament entirely. An IB private tutor Mumbai families find directly, with no layer in between, can be the cleanest arrangement of all: a direct relationship, often a lower rate, and nobody taking a cut. You also do the verifying, the renegotiating and the replacing alone, and there is no cover when they are ill in February.

This is the whole of why you would choose IB Gram in Mumbai over doing it yourself: a filter on board, subject, level and travel; verification done before you meet anyone; and a replacement path that does not leave you starting from nothing in the middle of a term. It suits a family new to the city or new to the board, a family who has already tried one arrangement that failed, a family needing a scarce HL subject, and a family who simply does not have the evenings to screen six strangers. We take requests for all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes Mumbai-wide, which is the other case it suits: siblings on different boards in the same house. It does not suit everyone, and the next section says where it does not.
bullets: School teacher: unmatched criteria knowledge, almost no slots, awkward conflicts

sections.heading: What progress looks like, and when IB Gram is the wrong choice in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see process rather than grades: homework attempted before the session instead of during it, the student able to say what the current task is marked on, and fewer questions of the type that mean nothing was understood last month. At one term, expect movement on the specific things the tutor targeted, usually a stronger IA draft, cleaner method marks or a visible change in timed-paper performance. At one full examination cycle, expect a trend, and expect it to be partly outside the tutor's control. School teaching, illness, the student's own effort and how early you started all sit in that result. We do not guarantee grades, and anyone in this city who does is selling you something other than teaching.

Now the part most comparison pages leave out. If you already have a tutor your child works well with, you do not need us, and swapping a working relationship for a new one in the middle of a DP2 year is a bad trade however good the new profile looks. If what your child needs is volume of timed past papers in a group at the lowest possible cost, a neighbourhood coaching class in Ghatkopar or Vashi will serve that better than one-to-one home tuition, and we will say so on the call. If a trusted parent at your own school has already named someone who teaches your child's exact subject and has a free slot, take it; that recommendation carries information we cannot generate.

There are two more cases where we are the wrong answer, and which is why some families choose IB Gram in Mumbai for a single term and then stop. The first is a problem that is not academic. A student who has stopped attending, who is in genuine distress, or who is dealing with something a tutor is not qualified to touch needs the school counsellor and the family first; adding two sessions a week to that week makes things worse, not better. The second is a parent looking for someone to produce the work. We will not supply a tutor who writes an Extended Essay or an Internal Assessment, and a request framed that way is one we turn down rather than quietly reassign.

The honest summary: a matching platform is a way to reduce search cost and risk when you do not already have a trusted answer. It is not a shortcut to a grade, it is not cheaper than a group class, and it does not replace the school. Where it earns its place is the first match, the verification you would otherwise do yourself, and the February week when a tutor stops answering and somebody has to find a replacement who can teach the same syllabus in the same node.

sections.heading: Starting with an IB home tutor in Mumbai: what to prepare
paragraphs: Four things make the first conversation useful. The most recent report card or progress sheet, with the teacher comments intact rather than summarised. The subject list with levels written exactly as entered: HL, SL, Core or Extended, and whether the sitting is the May or the October and November series. Any task sheet for work in progress, because an IA brief tells a tutor more in thirty seconds than a paragraph of description. And three weekday slots that actually work in your house, allowing for the commute home.

The first session then runs as a diagnostic. The tutor gives the student something from their own syllabus to attempt, watches how they work rather than whether they get it right, and identifies where the gap actually sits. Very often the reported problem is not the real one: a student described as weak at Physics is frequently weak at rearranging equations, and a student described as weak at Economics cannot structure a paragraph against a command term. You should get a short readout at the end of that session saying what the plan is for the next four.

If you want to compare before you commit, compare properly. Ask a coaching class how many students sit in the batch and how they handle a student two topics behind. Ask a chain institute whether your allocated teacher can change mid-term and who decides. Ask a marketplace tutor which board and series they last taught. Ask us the same questions, and ask what happens if the match fails in week three. The answers will tell you which of these is built for your situation, and sometimes that will not be us.

When you are ready, send the enquiry with the board, the year, the subject and your area, and say plainly whether you want a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects Mumbai parents usually request individually, or help with one. We will tell you honestly if the match is thin in your node, and we would rather say that in the first conversation than three weeks into a term.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram a tutoring institute, an agency or something else?
faqs.answer: IB Gram is an independent matching platform, not an institute and not a school. We do not run centres, batches or a syllabus of our own. What we do is take a request, filter tutors on board, subject, level and realistic travel, verify the people we introduce, and stay involved if the match needs replacing. The teaching relationship is between you and the tutor. We are also not affiliated with any school, with the International Baccalaureate Organisation, with Cambridge International Education or with Pearson Edexcel, and we do not guarantee grades.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai actually depend on?
faqs.answer: IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on five things, and we will not quote a figure because any number we print would be wrong for most readers. Board and level come first: a DP HL subject costs more per hour than an early MYP subject. Subject scarcity is second, and HL Further Mathematics or a less common second language sits at the top of that. Travel distance is third, which is why node-to-node matching tends to be cheaper. Session length and frequency are fourth, and the fifth is the tutor's own board teaching record.

faqs.question: Why use a platform instead of asking my child's own school teacher?
faqs.answer: Often you should ask the school teacher first, and we will say that. Nobody knows the internal assessment criteria, the department's marking habits and the actual expectations better than someone teaching that course in that school. The reasons families end up elsewhere are practical: very few private slots exist, many Mumbai schools restrict staff from teaching their own students privately, and the conflict of interest becomes uncomfortable if a predicted grade is ever disputed. A platform is the alternative when that door is closed, not a claim to be a better option.

faqs.question: We already have a tutor who works. Do we need IB Gram at all?
faqs.answer: No. The real answer to why choose IB Gram in Mumbai is situational, and your situation already has a solution. A working tutor relationship is worth more than any profile we could send, because rapport and accumulated knowledge of a student take months to rebuild. Changing tutors mid-DP2 is close to always a bad trade. The only cases worth a conversation are a new subject that tutor does not teach, a sibling on a different board, or a scheduling collapse they cannot absorb. Otherwise keep what works.

faqs.question: Is a coaching class in Ghatkopar cheaper than one-to-one home tuition?
faqs.answer: Yes, considerably, and for some students it is also the better choice. A coaching class in Ghatkopar or Vashi spreads the cost across a batch and creates a pace for drilling past papers against a clock that one-to-one teaching struggles to reproduce. Where it struggles is the individual gap: a student two topics behind does not get back-filled, mixed boards often share a room, and an Internal Assessment needs a one-to-one conversation. If cost and paper volume are the priority, a class fits better and we will tell you so.

faqs.question: Will a tutor really travel to Kasarvadavali on Ghodbunder Road on a weekday evening?
faqs.answer: Only if they already live on that side of Thane, which is exactly how we match. A tutor near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali in about twenty minutes off-peak and nearly an hour at the evening peak on Ghodbunder Road, so a 6pm slot booked by someone travelling from Mulund or Powai will be renegotiated within a month. We match Thane requests to Thane tutors, and Navi Mumbai requests node to node along Palm Beach Road. If the local pool is thin for your subject, we say so instead of booking a slot that fails.

faqs.question: How do society gate passes and visitor rules work for home tuition?
faqs.answer: Give your society office the tutor's full name and the standing day and time before the first session, and most Mumbai complexes will issue a recurring visitor entry rather than making them register weekly. Ask whether your building requires a resident to approve each entry by app or intercom, because that becomes your job every week. We also suggest the first two or three home tuition sessions happen in a room with an open door or in the building's study area, and that someone is home, particularly for younger students.

faqs.question: Does online tuition genuinely work for DP Mathematics and Physics?
faqs.answer: Yes for most DP1 and DP2 students, with two caveats. Older students manage a screen well, and an IB online tutor in Mumbai can be the HL specialist who happens to live three suburbs away, with no lost session when the Western Express Highway stops moving. The caveats are hand-drawn work and attention. Graph sketching, uncertainty tables and long derivations are slower to share, so a writing tablet makes a real difference. And a student who is disengaged rather than behind will manage a camera far more easily than a person at the table.

faqs.question: There has been no progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Ask for specifics before you conclude anything, because month-one progress is process rather than marks. The questions are: is homework being attempted before the session, can the student name what the current task is marked against, and has the tutor given you a written plan for the next four weeks? If the answers are no, tell us. We will either reset the plan with the same tutor or rematch. If the answers are yes but the marks have not moved, that is normal at four weeks and worth another month before judging.

faqs.question: Can we change tutors, and what does that involve?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is a normal request rather than a complaint. Tell us the match is not working, ideally with one concrete reason, and we rematch from the same filtered pool. There is no notice period, no contract to exit and no requirement to justify the decision at length. Two sessions is usually enough information. What helps the second match is specificity: a tutor who was too gentle, too fast, or who explained concepts well but never touched the mark scheme tells us what to screen for next time.

faqs.question: How is this different from an online marketplace with thousands of tutors?
faqs.answer: The difference is who does the vetting and who carries the risk. A marketplace hands you the widest choice and the fastest booking, then leaves you to confirm qualifications, judge board experience and absorb the loss if the person has never taught the syllabus. Many of those tutors are online only and some are outside India, so the Mumbai calendar and the evening commute mean nothing to them. We introduce fewer people, verify them first, match on travel, and stay accountable for a replacement. If you prefer screening people yourself, a marketplace is the cheaper route.

faqs.question: Is IB Gram connected to my child's school or to the IB itself?
faqs.answer: No. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school mentioned on this site, nor with the International Baccalaureate Organisation, Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel. Schools are named here only as context, because their calendars set the deadlines our tutors work around. No tutor we introduce speaks for a school, negotiates with teachers on your behalf, or has access to internal marking. If anyone claiming to represent us tells you otherwise, that is worth reporting to us directly.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram find an IB and IGCSE home tutor in Worli Sea Face?
paragraphs: You send one brief, IB Gram shortlists from tutors already teaching inside the island city, and the society paperwork starts in the same week as the teaching plan. sections.heading: Which programme are you actually buying help for in Mumbai?
paragraphs: Parents on Worli Sea Face often say IB and IGCSE in one breath, and the schools encourage it, because most families here cross from one to the other somewhere around Year 9. They are not the same system. The International Baccalaureate (IB) runs three programmes: the Primary Years Programme (PYP) through Year 5, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) through Year 10, and the Diploma Programme (DP) across Years 11 and 12. Cambridge International Education runs IGCSE across Years 9 to 11, examined by terminal papers in the May or the November series.

In PYP the work a tutor does is rarely subject rescue. It is reading fluency, number sense and the habit of explaining an answer out loud, which is the part the unit of inquiry quietly assesses. MYP changes the vocabulary completely. Each subject group is marked against four criteria, each scored out of eight, and a student who writes well can still lose Criterion D because the task asked for reflection and she produced description. A tutor who has never read an MYP criterion grid will coach the wrong thing for an entire term and both of you will believe it is going well.

IGCSE is the most procedural of the four and the easiest to improve quickly. Papers are predictable, command words repeat, and mark schemes reward a specific shape of answer. The Core and Extended decision in subjects such as Mathematics, Physics and Economics should be made with the school and a tutor who has taught both tiers, because Core caps the attainable grade while Extended punishes a student who is not ready for it. A Year 10 moved up or down at the right moment changes the shape of the whole year.

The Diploma Programme is a two-year machine with its own internal clock. Six subjects at Higher Level (HL) or Standard Level (SL), plus Theory of Knowledge (TOK), the Extended Essay (EE) and Creativity, Activity, Service. The internal assessments are not homework. They are coursework carrying a fixed share of the final subject grade, drafted once, commented on once and then submitted. A DP1 student who lets the first draft deadline slide in February has removed her only feedback round, and no quantity of tutoring in April puts it back.
bullets: PYP work is oral explanation and number sense, not worksheet volume.
MYP subjects are marked against four criteria, each scored out of eight.
Core versus Extended at IGCSE caps or raises the attainable grade.
DP internal assessments carry a fixed share of the final subject grade.

sections.heading: Subject choice, HL and SL, Core and Extended: what a Worli Sea Face tutor has to know
paragraphs: A brief that says all IB and IGCSE subjects really means one tutor in Worli Sea Face for the two that are slipping and nothing at all for the rest. That is the honest version. Families here rarely need eight subjects covered. They need Mathematics steadied, a science unblocked, and sometimes an English or Economics teacher who can read a mark scheme out loud. The platform covers the full range so the brief can change in October without starting over, not so that every subject gets booked in June.

The decisions that actually move a grade happen before any tutoring starts. At Higher Level a DP subject adds content and a harder paper, and a student taking three HL sciences because a university website mentioned them is the commonest self-inflicted wound in Mumbai. At IGCSE the Core and Extended split does the same job two years earlier. A tutor who has taught both tiers can usually tell you within three sessions whether Extended is a stretch worth taking or a grade thrown away, and that single conversation is worth more than a term of revision.

Take a Year 11 student at Aditya Birla World Academy preparing Cambridge IGCSE Economics 0455. Paper 2 ends with an extended question asking her to discuss whether a government should subsidise public transport. She knows the content. She writes accurate definitions, draws a clean diagram, explains both sides, and still lands below the top band, because the question asked for a judgement supported by her own analysis and she never made one. The repair is not more Economics. It is twenty minutes a week rewriting the final paragraph until it names a decision, gives a reason drawn from her own diagram, and qualifies it. That is a component-level fix, and it is exactly what a tutor sitting at your table can spot in a single session.

Every programme carries coursework assessed against published criteria, and criteria are learnable. The MYP personal project, the DP internal assessment in each subject, the Extended Essay and the IGCSE coursework options all reward a student who has read the descriptors rather than guessed at them. A tutor's most useful hour is often spent reading the criteria aloud with your child and having her mark her own draft against them. She will find three of the four problems herself, which is also how she stops needing a tutor.

sections.heading: Worli Sea Face, Worli, Prabhadevi and Mahalaxmi: where your tutor travels from
paragraphs: Worli Sea Face is the curve of towers facing the bay, and the catchment that matters for scheduling is small: Worli immediately behind it, Prabhadevi to the north, Mahalaxmi to the south east. The nearest station is Prabhadevi on the Western Line, a short ride from Churchgate, Grant Road and Mumbai Central, which is how most tutors without a car arrive. The Coastal Road has cut the drive down the western edge sharply, and Metro Line 3 between Cuffe Parade and BKC has widened the pool of people who can commit to a weekday evening here. Harbour Line stops at Dockyard Road and Sewri sit on the other side of the island for anyone coming from the east.

South Mumbai is dense and short in distance but slow in practice. A tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers about eight kilometres and can still lose forty minutes to the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak. That is why tutors here are matched within the island rather than brought down from the suburbs. A phone search for IB and IGCSE tutors near me from Worli Sea Face will surface profiles in Lower Parel, Parel and Tardeo, and those are the ones worth calling, because the person who answers from Kandivali will be punctual for three weeks and then start arriving at half past six.

The promenade itself sets the rhythm of the evening. Families walk it after school, the stretch fills from around five, and parking along the sea-facing side disappears with it. A tutor driving in needs to know in advance whether your tower offers visitor parking in the basement or expects the car to be left on the service road behind. Omkar 1973 and Piramal Aranya handle this differently, and the answer quietly decides whether a six o'clock start is realistic or whether the session should simply be set for half past six and protected.

Mumbai, Maharashtra is a city where a ten-minute map estimate routinely means half an hour, so IB Gram matches on lived commute rather than on distance. An IB and IGCSE home tutor in Worli Sea Face who lives in Prabhadevi or Mahalaxmi will hold a Tuesday and Thursday slot for a full term. One brought across the city will not, however good the first month looks, and a slot that collapses in week seven costs the student more than the saving ever bought.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar families on Worli Sea Face plan around
paragraphs: Ryan Global School has a Worli campus and Aditya Birla World Academy sits a short drive away at Tardeo, and between them they account for a large share of the children in these towers. Families here also travel to Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, Bombay International School at Babulnath and B.D. Somani International School at Cuffe Parade. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with Ryan Global School, Aditya Birla World Academy or any other school named on this page. We name them because their calendars set the dates your tutoring has to work around.

The Mumbai school year opens in June, and the first real pressure point lands in late August, when MYP criteria tasks and the first assessed IGCSE assignments arrive in the same fortnight. October brings mid-terms and the DP1 internal assessment proposals. The hardest stretch of the year for a DP2 student is the back half of January, when mock examinations, the Extended Essay final submission and two or three internal assessment deadlines overlap. February and March belong to the remaining internal assessment uploads, and May is the examination series itself.

The consequence for a family on Worli Sea Face is that tutoring booked in January is tutoring booked late. A tutor who starts in June has four clear months to build a working method before the first serious deadline. One who starts in the week of the mocks spends the entire engagement triaging. If your child is in DP1 now, the useful window is the one you are standing in. Waiting until the report card confirms what you already suspect leaves the tutor a shorter runway than the problem needs.

Schools around here also expect a particular kind of independence, and that shapes what good tutoring should look like. Teachers at these schools give detailed written feedback and expect the student to act on it without being told twice. A tutor who rewrites a paragraph for your child has solved this week and created next week. The right instruction is to read the teacher's comment, work out what it is asking for, and attempt the fix before the tutor says a word.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid for an IB and IGCSE student in Worli Sea Face?
paragraphs: Home tutoring is the lead service and it is what almost every family on Worli Sea Face asks for first. IB and IGCSE home tuition in Worli Sea Face usually settles into two evenings a week at the dining table, the tutor arriving between six and half past with the school bag already open. What home tuition buys you is attention you can see. You hear the explanation, you notice the moment your child goes quiet, and the tutor sees the physical state of the folder, which says more about organisation than any report card ever will.

An IB and IGCSE online tutor in Worli Sea Face solves two problems that home classes cannot. The first is scarcity. If your child needs Higher Level Computer Science or a less common Language B, the person who has genuinely taught it may be in Pune or Chennai, and insisting on travel removes them from the list entirely. The second is the gate. If a pass lapses, if the society office is shut for a festival, or if the Coastal Road is closed for an event, the session still happens. Online loses the informal reading of body language and it demands a student who will keep the camera on.

Hybrid is what most long engagements become by the second term, and it is better planned than drifted into. One session a week in person for the teaching that needs a shared page and a pencil, one online for drill, past-paper walkthroughs and marking a draft on screen. In examination months the balance tips the other way: short frequent online check-ins beat one long visit, because what a student needs in April is accountability and pacing rather than new content.

The trade-off nobody mentions is the cost of travel inside a tutor's day. A home tutor crossing Mumbai for a single hour is spending two unpaid hours in traffic, and that cost shows up eventually as lateness, cancellation or a fee that reflects the commute. Matching inside the island keeps that pressure off the arrangement entirely. For families who want a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai across two or three children, two tutors sharing the week is almost always steadier than one heroic schedule.

sections.heading: How are tutors verified before they are registered at your Worli Sea Face gate?
paragraphs: Every tutor on the platform submits government photo identity, their degree or teaching qualification, and a record of which boards and which syllabus codes they have actually taught. We check the identity document against the name on the qualification, speak to at least one previous family, and ask the tutor to explain a recent assessment they marked. That last step filters more applicants than the paperwork does. Someone who has genuinely taught the Diploma Programme can describe a criterion grid and a moderation process without being prompted for either.

Verification matters more on Worli Sea Face than in most of Mumbai, because the identity you submit to the society office becomes a permanent record. The pass carries a photograph, a name and a flat number, and it stays on file long after the engagement ends. Hiring an IB and IGCSE private tutor in Worli Sea Face straight off a noticeboard or a building group means you are personally sponsoring that person's access to a secured tower on the strength of a short conversation. The society will hold you responsible for that access, and reasonably so.

There are four things worth checking yourself, and none of them take long. Ask which board and which specific syllabus the tutor last taught, and listen for the code rather than the subject name. Ask what the student's grade was at the start and at the end, and be suspicious of any answer with no setback anywhere in it. Ask to see a marked piece of work with the tutor's own handwritten comments on it. And ask the tutor directly what they will not teach, because a person who claims every subject at every level is telling you something useful.

Verification is not a promise about outcomes. It tells you the person is who they say they are and has taught what they say they have taught. It does not tell you they will suit your particular child, which is why the first fortnight is treated as a trial and why changing tutors early carries no penalty at all. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and a tutor who does should be asked to put the mechanism in writing.

sections.heading: Strict visitor registration on Worli Sea Face and the standing gate pass
paragraphs: Worli Sea Face is a line of sea-facing towers with strict visitor registration, and the practical effect is that tutors here are given a standing gate pass rather than being cleared session by session. The registration itself is unremarkable once you have done it once. The society office, usually on the ground floor or at podium level, takes a copy of the tutor's government photo identity, a passport photograph, the flat number, the days and the time band of the visit, and the name of the resident sponsoring the entry. Some towers add a police verification form for anyone attending more than twice a week. Most either issue a card or add the tutor to a resident-approved list inside the building's visitor app.

Per-visit clearance sounds harmless until you watch it happen at ten to six. The tutor reaches the lobby, the desk has no standing entry, so the guard sends an approval request up to the flat through the app. Your child is in the shower, the intercom goes unanswered, and you are in a meeting in BKC with your phone face down. Five minutes becomes fifteen. Do that twice a week for a term and you have lost the better part of five hours of teaching, and worse, you have taught your child that the session starts whenever it happens to start. A standing pass removes the negotiation completely. The tutor walks in, signs the register, and the hour is an hour.

Set this up in the week before teaching begins, not on the evening itself. Tell the society office that a tutor will be visiting on fixed days, give them the name and identity details we send you after the match is confirmed, and ask specifically for a standing or long-term visitor entry rather than a daily pass. Confirm who the sponsoring resident will be, because in most towers it must be the flat owner or a registered occupant rather than a visiting relative. Add the tutor to your visitor app yourself with a recurring entry across both days and the time band. Then ask what happens when the pass expires, because many societies run them quarterly and drop the entry without telling anyone.

Two edges catch families out. The first is the lift. Several towers here run access-controlled lifts where a visitor needs a resident to tap them through or needs the guard to send the car up, so a pass at the gate is not the same thing as a pass to the twenty-eighth floor. Check both, on the same visit. The second is substitution. If your regular tutor is unwell and a colleague covers the session, that colleague is an unregistered visitor at a gate that does not make exceptions. Ask the society how a named substitute is handled before you need it, and tell us, so we propose cover from someone already on your approved list.

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks you should not be looking at marks. You should be looking at whether your child can say what she is bad at. A student who moves from a vague sense of being weak at Physics to naming the exact failure, that she loses marks when the question says explain and she describes instead, has made the only change that compounds. Alongside that, the folder should be in order, homework should be starting earlier in the evening, and the tutor should have given you one written sentence about what changes next. If none of that has happened by week four, say so immediately.

At one term you should see movement in school assessments, though rarely a clean jump. A grade four becoming a five at MYP, or a C becoming a B at IGCSE, is the normal shape of a good term. Larger jumps do happen, but usually where the problem turned out to be one specific gap rather than a general weakness. What matters more than the number is the variance. A student scoring consistently inside a band is in better shape than one alternating between two bands, because consistency under time pressure is what an examination paper actually rewards in May.

Across a full examination cycle the honest picture is that tutoring changes the probability, not the outcome. The student sits the paper alone, in a hall, with no help. IB Gram does not guarantee grades, and neither does any tutor worth hiring. What a good engagement does is strip out the avoidable losses: the misread command word, the Paper 2 left unfinished, the internal assessment submitted with no reflection section. Those are worth real marks, and they are the part a tutor can genuinely control.

There are limits worth naming out loud. Tutoring does not fix attendance, it does not fix a subject chosen against a student's will, and it rarely fixes a student who does not want to be in the room. It also cannot compress two years of Diploma Programme content into April. If a tutor suggests otherwise, ask for the plan in writing with dates against it and watch what happens next. IB Gram is an independent platform, which means we carry no incentive to keep a poor match running.

sections.heading: Starting home classes in Worli Sea Face: what to have ready
paragraphs: Three things turn the first session from an interview into a diagnosis. The most recent school report, including the teacher comments, which are almost always more useful than the grades beside them. One piece of assessed work with the marking still on it, ideally something your child did badly on rather than her best effort. And the subject's assessment calendar for the term, which the school publishes and most parents have never opened. A tutor who sees those three before arriving walks in with a hypothesis already formed.

On the household side, pick the room before the tutor arrives. The dining table with the television off works better than a bedroom desk, because a bedroom invites the phone and the bed into the hour. Decide whether a parent sits in. For PYP and early MYP it usually helps. From Year 9 upwards it usually does not, and the student talks noticeably less. Settle the gate paperwork in the preceding week so the first evening is teaching rather than a conversation in the lobby about who the person at the gate is.

The first session itself is a diagnostic. The tutor will work through a recent paper or task alongside your child rather than lecturing, because the point is to find where the thinking breaks rather than to cover content. Expect to be told something uncomfortable and specific. At the end you should receive a written plan: what the next four sessions cover, what your child does between them, and what you ought to be able to see by week four. If that plan does not arrive, chase it in writing.

An IB and IGCSE home tutor in Worli Sea Face is not a subscription you set and forget. Review the arrangement at four weeks and again at the end of the term, and change it when the brief changes, which it will when subject choices are finalised or when a DP1 turns into a DP2. Tell us when the pressure moves. The tutor who was right for consolidation in August is not automatically the right one for internal assessment drafting in January.

faqs.question: How does the gate pass for a home tutor on Worli Sea Face actually get issued?
faqs.answer: Through your society office, in your name, before the first session. You hand over the tutor's government photo identity and a passport photograph, which we send you once the match is confirmed, along with the flat number, the teaching days and the time band. Most towers on Worli Sea Face then either issue a standing visitor card or add the tutor to a resident-approved list inside the building's visitor app. Some ask for a police verification form where the visit is more than twice a week. faqs.question: What if my tutor arrives and the gate has no record of them?
faqs.answer: Expect to lose the first fifteen minutes, which is precisely why the standing pass is worth the paperwork. The usual causes are a quarterly expiry nobody flagged, a guard shift change where the register was not handed over, or a visitor app entry logged as a single date rather than a recurring one. Ask your society office for the expiry date in writing on the day the pass is issued, and set a reminder a fortnight before it falls due. If a session is going to start late anyway, the tutor should run it online from the lobby rather than surrender the whole hour.

faqs.question: What do IB and IGCSE tuition fees in Worli Sea Face depend on?
faqs.answer: Five things, and we will not quote a figure because the honest range is wide. Board and level, since Diploma Programme Higher Level costs more than IGCSE Core. Subject scarcity, because Higher Level Computer Science or a rarer Language B has far fewer qualified teachers in Mumbai than Mathematics does. Travel, because a tutor crossing Peddar Road in the evening peak prices that time into the hour. Session length and frequency, since two ninety-minute sessions are not simply twice a forty-five-minute one. And timing, because a tutor booked for January mocks is scarcer than one booked in June.

faqs.question: Can a tutor from Bandra or Powai take an evening slot on Worli Sea Face?
faqs.answer: They can, and for one term it will usually hold, which is exactly the problem. The arrangement looks fine in June and then quietly degrades. Crossing into South Mumbai for a six o'clock start means leaving in the middle of the afternoon, and after a few weeks the tutor begins arriving at twenty past, then rescheduling, then dropping the second session. We match within the island for that reason: Worli, Prabhadevi, Mahalaxmi, Lower Parel and Tardeo. If the subject is rare enough that nobody on the island teaches it, we say so and propose online instead of pretending the commute is sustainable.

faqs.question: Who is the best IB and IGCSE tutor in Worli Sea Face?
faqs.answer: There is no such person, and anyone who answers that question with a single name is selling something. The right tutor is defined by your brief: a Diploma Programme Chemistry Higher Level specialist is a poor match for a Year 6 Primary Years Programme reader, however good she is at her own subject. Look instead for board-specific experience in the exact programme and year, real availability inside your evening window, and a willingness to be replaced without drama if the fit is wrong. Ask about a student they failed to help and why. That answer tells you more than any list of grades.

faqs.question: There has been no visible progress after a month. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Say it out loud in week four rather than week ten. Start by checking the right signal: at four weeks what matters is whether your child can name the specific error she makes, not whether her marks moved. If she cannot, the tutor has been teaching content instead of diagnosing. Ask the tutor directly what the written plan said would change, and whether it changed. If the answer is vague, we replace the tutor, and the replacement inherits the gate registration and the diagnostic notes so you do not lose a second fortnight to setup.

faqs.question: Does online tutoring really work for Diploma Programme subjects?
faqs.answer: Yes for some things and poorly for others, and the split is predictable enough to plan around. Online is strong for past-paper walkthroughs, marking a draft on a shared screen, and short accountability check-ins during examination months. It is weak in the first six weeks with a student who has not yet admitted what she does not understand, because that admission usually arrives through body language rather than speech. Our standard recommendation on Worli Sea Face is to begin at home, build the relationship in person, and shift the second weekly session online once the student is talking freely.

faqs.question: Where in the home should the lesson actually happen?
faqs.answer: The dining table, with the television off and the phone in another room. Bedrooms lose roughly ten minutes a session to the bed, the laptop and the closed door. If your flat has a study, use it, but keep the door open, because the point is not supervision so much as the fact that an open door changes how both people behave. Towers such as Omkar 1973 and Piramal Aranya have common study rooms or clubhouse areas that some families prefer for older students, though you should confirm first whether a registered visitor is permitted to use them.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after six weeks?
faqs.answer: You tell us, we replace them, and there is no argument about it. The first fortnight is explicitly a trial, and a change inside the first six weeks is routine rather than a complaint. What we ask for is specificity. A comment that she is not improving is much harder to act on than a comment that he explains well but never checks whether she understood. The second one tells us precisely what to match for. The incoming tutor receives the diagnostic notes and the term plan, and we reuse the existing society registration wherever the building allows a named substitution.

faqs.question: Do you cover Worli, Prabhadevi and Mahalaxmi as well as the Sea Face towers?
faqs.answer: Yes, and for IB and IGCSE home tuition in Worli Sea Face they are effectively one matching area. A tutor teaching a family in a Worli Sea Face tower will usually have another student in Worli or Prabhadevi, which is what makes a fixed Tuesday and Thursday slot viable over a whole term. Prabhadevi station on the Western Line anchors the catchment, and Mahalaxmi is a short drive south east. Lower Parel and Tardeo are in practical range too. We will not stretch a weekday evening match out to Bandra or Chembur, because that schedule breaks by the second term.

faqs.question: Does a parent need to be at home during the session?
faqs.answer: Not after roughly Year 8, and it is often better if you are not in the room at all. For Primary Years Programme and early Middle Years Programme students a parent nearby helps, mostly because the child stays on task. From IGCSE upwards your presence tends to make the student perform for you rather than admit confusion. Someone responsible should be in the home, both for the obvious reason and because your society's visitor rules usually require the sponsoring resident or a registered occupant to be present while a visitor is inside the flat.

faqs.question: How far ahead should we book before the May examination series?
faqs.answer: For May examinations the genuinely useful booking window closes around September. A tutor starting in June has four clear months before the first heavy deadline; one starting in January is triaging mocks, the Extended Essay submission and internal assessment uploads simultaneously. Strong subject specialists in Mumbai are also largely booked out by October, so a late request faces a thinner shortlist rather than a worse service. If you are already in January, book anyway, but ask the tutor to name the two things they intend to fix instead of attempting the whole syllabus again.

sections.heading: PYP, MYP, DP or IGCSE: which programme is your Worli child actually in?
paragraphs: Worli families sit across four structures at once. The International Baccalaureate (IB) runs the Primary Years Programme (PYP) to Grade 5, the Middle Years Programme (MYP) across Years 1 to 5, and the Diploma Programme (DP) in the final two years. Alongside it, Cambridge International Education and Pearson Edexcel run IGCSE across Years 9 to 11, with some schools continuing into AS and A Level instead of the DP. A tutor who has taught one of these well does not automatically transfer to another, because the assessment machinery is completely different even where the content overlaps.

The practical confusion in this part of Mumbai is the crossover year. A child finishing MYP 5 at one school and a child finishing IGCSE Year 11 at another both enter DP1 in the same June, and they arrive with different habits. The MYP student has written to criteria A to D for years and is comfortable with reflection and process, but has often never sat a timed paper with a mark scheme behind it. The IGCSE student has sat plenty of timed papers and knows how to collect marks, but meets the DP internal assessment and the research-led demands of the Extended Essay (EE) and Theory of Knowledge (TOK) cold. The first month of tutoring usually goes on whichever of those two gaps is actually present.

Year 9 is the other decision point. Core versus Extended at IGCSE, and the subject combination taken at that stage, quietly narrows what is available at Higher Level (HL) two years later. Parents in the Worli towers often ask us for all IB and IGCSE subjects run as home classes in Worli during Year 9 and Year 10, not because the child is failing, but because they want the combination kept open. That is a legitimate reason to start, and it is cheaper in effort than repairing a closed door in DP1.

Sibling pages on this site go deeper into single programmes and single levels. This page stays at the level of the whole house: which structure your child is in, who can teach it in Worli, and how the week actually gets arranged.
